title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 6691 Church Street in Riverdale, Georgia, as the "Major Gregory E. Barney Post Office Building".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 6691 Church Street in Riverdale, Georgia, as the "Major Gregory E. Barney Post Office Building."

summary.headline: Congress named a Riverdale, Georgia post office after Major Gregory E. Barney.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 6691 Church Street in Riverdale, Georgia, as the "Major Gregory E. Barney Post Office Building." It is a naming measure only and does not change how the post office operates or what services it provides. The official summary does not describe any other effects.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on July 29, 2016.
